tile.sampling_scope: One public 1-degree tile at N25 E010, approximately 25-26 degrees north and 10-11 degrees east; sample descriptor central Sahara, not an atlas boundary.
tile.last_modified_interpretation: Object-store hosting metadata only; not terrain acquisition or compilation time.
tile.retention: Tile was streamed to hash/inspect metadata and discarded; restore exact bytes from canonical URL and compare full-object hash. No raster is duplicated in Git.

tile_list.retention: Not bundled; restore the public tileList and compare its SHA-256.

header_inspection.method: GDAL gdalinfo -json -noct on /vsicurl/ public COG; an independent HTTP Range request fetched bytes 0-8191.

method: Inspect official product page, public distribution readme, GLO-90 full/free/open license, product handbook, tile manifest line, and one COG's full-object identity plus GDAL/GeoTIFF metadata. Do not classify terrain or infer earlier historical state.
known_uncertainties: No exact acquisition date or source-scene set for this tile is exposed in the selected public COG header.
Product-wide 2011-2015 acquisition frame has a documented older-data gap-fill exception.
Hosting last-modified dates are not acquisition or compilation dates.
